avatars.name: Yuki
avatars.description: A trainee who hardens their body in every skirmish.

avatars.name: Sable
avatars.description: A swift shadow warrior who sharpens your offensive edge.

avatars.name: Marina
avatars.description: Draws power from stamina reserves and steady stability.

avatars.name: Miku
avatars.description: An unyielding guardian who fortifies defences and counters blows.

avatars.name: Storm Reaper
avatars.description: A fearsome destroyer who doubles multi-hit fury and supercharges specials.

avatars.name: Eternal Inferno
avatars.description: A blazing titan who adds an extra hit to every multi-hit assault.

avatars.name: Abyssal Warden
avatars.description: A guardian of the deep who shrugs off all damage and punishes every attack.

avatars.name: Omega Prime
avatars.description: Exists beyond all known power. Never found in packs. Never duplicated.

avatars.name: Sukuna
avatars.description: The King of Curses. Unleashes cursed energy that shatters defence and guarantees lethal crits.

avatars.name: Zero Two
avatars.description: The partner-seeking Darling. Relentless multi-hit assault with surging charge and special move power.

avatars.name: Hinata
avatars.description: The determined ace spiker. High stamina and stability with a natural dodge instinct.

avatars.name: Mitsuha
avatars.description: The girl whose name connects worlds. Balanced across all stats with strong resistance.

avatars.name: Shadow Ninja
avatars.description: A phantom that cannot be hit. Maximum dodge, counter, and crit — every multi-hit strike lands harder and more often.

avatars.name: Alya
avatars.description: Sharp and calculated. Boosts attack speed and crit chance with quick charge recovery.

avatars.name: Gen
avatars.description: A genius tactician. Supercharges special moves and charge with exceptional stability.

avatars.name: Mikasa
avatars.description: The Ackerman. Unmatched in combat — devastating special moves and relentless multi-hit assault.

avatars.name: Taki
avatars.description: The boy who crossed time to find her. Surging charge and special move power with relentless momentum.

avatars.name: Yotsuha
avatars.description: Mitsuha's spirited little sister. Quick on her feet with reliable stamina and stability.

avatars.name: Reina
avatars.description: Proud and fierce. Enhances defence and counter instincts with sharp stability under pressure.

avatars.name: Okudera
avatars.description: Graceful and composed. Steady charge recovery and light defensive presence.

avatars.name: Tifa
avatars.description: AVALANCHE's iron fist. Demolishes defences with raw attack power, extra hits, and relentless crits.

avatars.name: Tessie
avatars.description: A dependable friend who lifts others up. Solid stamina and stability with light charge support.

avatars.name: Kanna
avatars.description: Quiet but watchful. Subtle resistance and steady dodging instinct.

avatars.name: Ymir
avatars.description: A warrior bound to Historia. Fierce attack presence with strong HP and counter instincts.

avatars.name: Historia
avatars.description: The true queen. Unshakeable HP and resistance — she endures all and rises stronger.

avatars.name: Mitsuri
avatars.description: The Love Hashira. Whip-fast multi-hit strikes with extreme crit and dodge — leaves no opening unfilled.

avatars.name: Shinobu
avatars.description: The Insect Hashira. Poisons with a smile — devastating resistance debuffs and status application with lethal counter precision.

avatars.name: Argus
avatars.description: The deathless sentinel. Argus strikes with overwhelming force and simply refuses to fall.

skills.name: Piercing Gaze
skills.description: Crit chance +40%. Every crit refunds 50 Special Gauge.

skills.name: Deathless
skills.description: The first lethal hit cannot kill — Argus is immortal for 2 rounds. Once per battle.

avatars.name: Dyrroth
avatars.description: The abyssal prince. Dyrroth shreds guard on the opening exchange and finishes with a monstrous ultimate.

skills.name: Rhythm of Ruin
skills.description: Every 3rd hit deals bonus damage worth 20% of total Attack.

skills.name: Guard Breaker
skills.description: Ignores 40-76% of enemy Defence for the first 3 rounds.

skills.name: Abyssal Verdict
skills.description: Special Move damage +111%, and the Bey's full Attack stat is added on top.

avatars.name: Mare
avatars.description: The unmoved bulwark. Mare does not dodge, does not counter, and does not need to — everything that reaches her simply stops.

skills.name: Standing Ground
skills.description: Attack +40 and Stamina +40 — the wall pushes back.

avatars.name: Cobra Titan
avatars.description: A coiled titan that never tires. Cobra Titan outlasts everything in the stadium and strikes the moment its opponent finally slows.

skills.name: Scaled Guard
skills.description: Stamina increased by a further 120%, and 12% of all incoming damage is absorbed by the scales.

avatars.name: Miffy
avatars.description: Small, soft, and entirely immovable. Miffy scales with whatever bey she is paired to — the sturdier the blade, the more absurd she becomes.

skills.name: Unbothered
skills.description: 8% of all incoming damage is shrugged off entirely.

skills.name: Plush Armour
skills.description: Defence increased by 50%, applied on top of the bey's own Defence.

avatars.name: Freya
avatars.description: Valkyrie of the shield-wall. Freya answers every blow with a heavier one, and what she cannot answer, she simply absorbs.

skills.name: Aegis of Asgard
skills.description: 15% of incoming damage is absorbed, and a blocked hit answers back — 25% counter chance.

avatars.name: Vexana
avatars.description: The Necrokeep queen. Vexana turns a duel into a séance — every Special she calls lands with the weight of everything she has already buried.

skills.name: Soul Steal
skills.description: Every 3rd hit lands an extra 18% of total Attack.

skills.name: Deathly Grasp
skills.description: Attack increased by 61 and Defence by 61.

avatars.name: Helcurt
avatars.description: The Shadow Ranger. Helcurt fights in a dark of his own making — you do not see the strike, only the result.

skills.name: Shadow Transition
skills.description: Crit chance +30%, and 5% of hits are avoided entirely.

skills.name: Nightfall Arrival
skills.description: Defence ignored — 55% to 80% of the opponent's Defence is pierced for the first 3 rounds.

skills.name: Deadly Stinger
skills.description: Attack increased by 96, and by a further 20%.

avatars.name: Eudora
avatars.description: Lightning Sorceress. Eudora does not build up to anything — the first strike is already the biggest one.

skills.name: Forked Lightning
skills.description: Attack increased by 62, and by a further 18%.

skills.name: Thunder's Wrath
skills.description: Crit chance +26%, and every Special fires an extra hit.

avatars.name: Dr. W. D. Gaster
avatars.description: The royal scientist who fell into his own creation and came apart across it. He is not in one place, he is not in one time, and he is still working.

skills.name: Wing Dings
skills.description: He speaks in a font nobody can read. Incoming damage cut 8%, and a 20% chance to shrug off any status the opponent tries to name him with.

skills.name: Scattered Across Time
skills.description: He is not entirely here. Attacks slip through him outright, and what misses gets answered — 35% counter off a dodge.

skills.name: Gaster Blaster
skills.description: The skull opens and the beam does the rest. Special damage +70%, and a 40% crit window to fire it through.

avatars.name: Rantaro Kiyama
avatars.description: Never stops spinning, and never stops talking about it. Rantaro wins by still being there when you are not.

skills.name: Roktavor Rush
skills.description: Winning an Attack matchup builds Attack — up to five times.

skills.name: Stamina Wheel
skills.description: Winning a Stamina matchup restores 1.5 stamina.

skills.name: Relentless Spin
skills.description: Below 35% stamina: +15 stability and 18% less damage taken.

avatars.name: Ken Midori
avatars.description: Three heads, one wall. Ken lets you tire yourself out against it.

skills.name: Guardian Wall
skills.description: A successful Defense cuts incoming damage by 22%.

skills.name: Kerbeus Lock
skills.description: A successful Defense has a 40% chance to drain 1.5 of the opponent's stamina.

skills.name: Fortress Core
skills.description: Below half HP: +20 stability every round.

avatars.name: Daigo Kurogami
avatars.description: The scythe finds the gap your guard leaves open, and then it finds it again.

skills.name: Death Scythe
skills.description: Winning an Attack matchup deals 22 bonus damage.

skills.name: Dark Pursuit
skills.description: Deals 25% more damage to an opponent below 40% HP.

skills.name: Death Spiral
skills.description: Consecutive Attack wins build toward a crit — three in a row and the next one lands.

avatars.name: Hoji Konda
avatars.description: Reads the board, plays the percentages, and never stoops to a brawl.

skills.name: Balanced Rotation
skills.description: Once three different moves have been played, every win grants +5 to all stats.

skills.name: Golden Eye
skills.description: Reading the opponent — a mirrored move — feeds 25 Special gauge.

avatars.name: Wakiya Murasaki
avatars.description: Armour with a temper. Hit it hard enough and it hits back harder.

skills.name: Wyvron Counter
skills.description: A successful Defense primes a 30-damage counter on the next exchange.

skills.name: Wild Wind
skills.description: A successful Defense cuts the opponent's Attack by 12 for two rounds.

skills.name: Wyvron Guard
skills.description: While stability is above 70%, incoming damage is cut by 20%.

avatars.name: Orochi Ginba
avatars.description: Fights on the beat. Let him find the tempo and the drop lands.

skills.name: Odax Smash
skills.description: Winning an Attack matchup adds 18% of your Attack stat as damage.

skills.name: Omni Rotation
skills.description: Once three different moves have been played, wins grant +8 Attack and +8 Stamina.

skills.name: Full Force
skills.description: With the Special gauge charged, Attack rises by 20.

avatars.name: Valt Aoi
avatars.description: The school's ace. Fast, direct, and completely out of patience.

skills.name: Valkyrie Strike
skills.description: Winning an Attack matchup adds 20% crit chance for the round.

skills.name: Brave Sword
skills.description: Each consecutive Attack win adds 14 damage, stacking to four.

skills.name: Victory Evolution
skills.description: Behind on Victory Points: +18 to all stats, every round.

avatars.name: Shu Kurenai
avatars.description: Balanced, unhurried, and better than you. Shu learns the shape of your game and takes it apart.

skills.name: Spriggan Adaptation
skills.description: Reads your habit — whichever move you lean on, Spriggan is ready for it.

skills.name: Storm Counter
skills.description: A successful Defense or Stamina matchup primes a 26-damage response.

skills.name: Ultimate Balance
skills.description: At critical HP or stamina: +18 stability and 20% less damage taken.
